question: How long am I locked out after typing the wrong password too many times?
reference_answer: To protect your account from guessing attacks, Ledgerly blocks sign-in for a while after repeated failures. When it happens After 5 failed sign-in attempts in a row, whether the wrong password or the wrong two-factor code, your profile is locked for 15 minutes.

question: After I close my workspace, how long can I still get it restored?
reference_answer: The 90-day period Data is kept for 90 days after closing. During that time the Owner can ask support to restore the workspace.

question: I'm moving to another tool and want a complete copy of everything, attachments included. How do I get it?
reference_answer: You can download everything in a workspace at any time. It is useful for backups, switching tools, or before closing the workspace.

question: When a client opens my invoice, can they see my personal name and picture?
reference_answer: Email notification choices are on their own page, Notification settings. Password and two-factor options are under **Profile > Security**; see Two-factor authentication.

question: I want everyone on my team to use a second sign-in step. What if someone loses their phone and has no backup?
reference_answer: Enter your email and password, then the current code. Codes change every 30 seconds.

question: How long does Ledgerly keep the invoices it issued to me for my subscription?
reference_answer: Data is kept for 90 days, then permanently deleted. During those 90 days the Owner can ask support to restore it (see Close your account).

question: I signed in on a hotel computer and forgot to log out. How do I kick that device off?
reference_answer: An active session is a browser or device that is currently signed in to your Ledgerly profile. Reviewing them is a quick way to spot unauthorized access.

question: If I upgrade from Starter to Pro in the middle of the month, do I pay the full Pro price again?
reference_answer: Only the workspace Owner can change the plan. Open **Settings > Subscription** and choose **Change plan**.

question: The prices I quote my customers already contain tax. How do I stop Ledgerly adding it a second time?
reference_answer: Some businesses quote prices that already include tax, which is common for consumer sales. Ledgerly supports this with a per-invoice switch.

question: What's the difference between a customer who is excused from tax and an invoice where the buyer accounts for the VAT themselves?
reference_answer: Ledgerly stores the certificate number but does not verify it. Keep a copy of the certificate in your records, since tax authorities may ask for it.

question: If I offer a client a payment plan, do the automatic reminders and late fees pause?
reference_answer: Clients pay each installment from their pay link by card or ACH, or you record offline payments by hand (see Record an offline payment). Each installment appears as a separate payment and the invoice shows Partial until the last one arrives.

question: I bought an annual plan last week and changed my mind. Can I get my money back?
reference_answer: This page covers refunds of what you pay Ledgerly. To refund a payment your own client made, see Refunds.

question: My client says they will dispute it with their bank. Is that the same thing as the dispute option inside Ledgerly?
reference_answer: If a client disputes only a late fee, mark the invoice Disputed and then use **Waive late fee** or **Reduce late fee** on the fee line. Ledgerly does not remove fees automatically, and Ledgerly support cannot remove them for you because the invoice and the fee belong to your workspace.

question: My region adds a state tax and a county tax on the same item. Can one invoice line carry both?
reference_answer: Some regions charge two separate taxes on the same sale, for example a state tax and a city tax, or a federal tax and a provincial tax. Ledgerly lets you put up to two taxes on each line.

question: I upgraded one of my businesses to Pro but the feature I need is still missing. What could be wrong?
reference_answer: Starter includes 1 workspace, Pro includes up to 3 and Enterprise has no limit. To add a workspace go to **Account menu > New workspace**.

question: How much cheaper is it to pay for a whole year of Pro at once instead of month by month?
reference_answer: You can pay for your Ledgerly subscription every month or once a year. The features of a plan are the same either way; only the billing rhythm and price differ.

question: There's one client I never want to charge penalties. Can I exempt just them without touching other customers?
reference_answer: Each invoice has a **Charge late fee** toggle in the invoice settings panel. Turn it off to exempt a single invoice, for example for a client with a special agreement.

reference_answer: The client chooses card or, for US dollar invoices, bank transfer. If partial payments are allowed, they can change the amount.

reference_answer: Choose **Reduce** instead and enter either a new amount or a percentage of the current fee. Ledgerly keeps the reduced amount as a fixed fee.

question: Can invoice emails show my own company address as the sender instead of Ledgerly's? What do I have to configure with my DNS host?

question: What do I need before I can set up SAML single sign-on for my team?
reference_answer: Single sign-on (SSO) lets your team sign in to Ledgerly with their company identity instead of a separate password. It is available on Enterprise only.

question: A client paid on day 25 after the due date but I'm only recording it on day 40. Will they be charged extra penalty for those days?
reference_answer: The date received matters. If a client actually paid on day 25 past due but you record it on day 40, set the date received to day 25 and Ledgerly removes any fee added for the days after the payment.

question: A client paid more than they owed. Where does the extra money go and how do I use it on their next bill?
reference_answer: A credit balance is money you owe a customer that can be used against their future invoices. It is shown on the customer record and on their statement.

question: What happens to late fees and the pay link when I void an invoice?
reference_answer: Voiding cancels an invoice that was already sent while keeping a record of it. The invoice stays in your history with the status Void, and its number is never reused.

question: How can I swap the credential my script uses for a new one without any outage?

question: How can I stop my team from accidentally sending tiny invoices?
reference_answer: A minimum invoice amount stops you, or your team, from sending an invoice whose total is below a number you choose. It is useful if processing a very small invoice costs you more than it earns.

question: How often can I send a manual reminder for the same invoice?
